punch-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Punch was founded in the mid-nineteenth century by Manuel López of Juan Valle y Cía with the English market in mind, and Mr. Punch, the clown of the magazine, still appears on every box. Since 1931 it has shared the La Corona factory with Hoyo de Monterrey, using Vuelta Abajo wrapper and filler. Medium in strength, it is sweet, woody and lightly spiced, with hay and citrus.

thirds.notes: A sweet, caramel-like opening with cedar, baking spice and a faint pepper on the retrohale.
Honeyed and slightly vegetal, with soft wood, citrus rind, white pepper and a dense, creamy smoke.
Grassier and earthier, with cedar, baking spice and a darker brown-sugar sweetness to close.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Punch Punch review

punch-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Punch's Ediciones Limitadas use tobacco given at least two extra years of ageing under a wrapper from the upper leaves of the shaded plant; they include the Serie d'Oro No. 2 of 2013 and the Regios de Punch, a short 48-ring cigar unveiled at the 2017 Habano Festival. The Regios is creamy and mild, turning earthy with dark cocoa near the end.

thirds.notes: Creamy and smooth, with spice on the lips and a herbal, vegetal turn typical of the brand.
A subtle sweetness and very creamy texture, with almond and other nutty notes.
Fresh earth and cut grass lead into dark cocoa and wood as the strength rises slightly.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – Punch Regios de Punch Limited Edition 2017
Cigar Inspector – Punch Regios de Punch (EL 2017) review

punch-cuba--edicion-regional.description: Punch is among the Habanos brands used for Ediciones Regionales: cigars sold only in a given territory, made from the brand's usual blend in sizes it does not normally offer, in numbered boxes with a silver and burgundy seal and a second band naming the market. The Short de Punch format has served several of these regional releases.
